_what_this_is: Contains flight-level detail: flight numbers, scheduled departure times, operating airline and aircraft type per route. These are AeroDataBox Contents, not my own analysis.
_do_not_publish_until: AeroDataBox has confirmed in writing that the Plan Terms of your plan permit showing these fields to end users (Article 5.6), and the Contents were obtained through a paid channel (Article 5.3). Aircraft registrations are deliberately excluded even then.
_retention_note: If permission covers display only and not storage, treat this file as a cache: delete and regenerate within 7 days (Article 5.5).

B38M.concession: 737 MAX 8: LEAP engines, 197 vs 189 seats, about 8% more efficient

B734F.concession: 737-400F: one generation older, about 4 tonnes less payload

BCS1.concession: A220-100: 3.7 m shorter, about 20 fewer seats

candidates.name: London Stansted
candidates.why: CARGO: Qatar Airways Cargo 777F on STN-BRU and STN-MXP. Immediately adds two new 777F pairs with EBBR.

candidates.name: Paris Charles de Gaulle
candidates.why: CARGO number 2: base of ASL Airlines France and West Atlantic, the largest FedEx hub in Europe, and a Qatar Airways Cargo station. Makes CDG-ATH and OPO-CDG flyable with the 737-800BCF.

candidates.name: London Gatwick
candidates.why: The missing London link for LFBD, LFBZ, LEZL, LPPR and LGKR: they do have London traffic, just not to EGLL.

candidates.name: Leipzig/Halle
candidates.why: CARGO: DHL hub; EAT Leipzig and Star Air, which you already came across at LFBD.

candidates.name: Madrid Barajas
candidates.why: Completes the Iberian cluster; Iberia to KSFO; Qatar Airways 18-21 weekly to OTHH; also a Qatar Airways Cargo station.

candidates.name: Liege
candidates.why: CARGO number 1: home base of ASL Airlines Belgium with 24 Boeing 737-800BCFs, plus a Qatar Airways Cargo station. Unlocks your entire B7 block, which currently has zero pairs.
